rationale: Small defensive spot trim (8 percent) for the overnight gap, not a top call. Three measurable structural facts justify acting even though the reduce gate never fired: 4H MACD histogram collapsed 70 percent (252.28 to 76.21 since midday) while price barely moved, open interest fell 0.44 percent while price was flat to slightly down (the same OI-divergence signature the 21 September endday lesson used to justify its own trim), and Fear and Greed cooled from 78 Extreme Greed to 71 Greed. None of these invalidate the uptrend - price is still above every EMA on all four timeframes and the L/S account ratio is still net-short at 0.94 - but the next report is roughly nine and a half hours away, the longest unprotected window of the day, so a small trim raises cash for tomorrow while 92 percent of the position keeps running.

message.text: I trimmed 8 percent of the spot book at 86,482.4 for the overnight gap - momentum is decelerating (4H MACD histogram down 70 percent since midday) and OI fell 0.44 percent while price stalled, but the uptrend structure is intact: price above every EMA, L/S ratio still net-short at 0.94. Cash is raised for you to act rather than watch. Read it this way. The 86,632.6 add gate has now gone three sessions without a single settled 1H close above it, even though price wicked through it twice - keep honouring the settled-close rule, it has been undefeated all week. Reduce gate is 85,325.2, unmoved for a fourth session and un-threatened (today's low was 86,001.8, 676.6 points clear). I trailed the invalidation up from the stale 84,719.5 to 85,111.1 - today's actual tested overnight low from the earlier spike - and set a resting stop at 85,050.0 just under it, since the futures book is flat and has no other protection. The realized-liquidation feed's 100-fill cap could not see fills above 85,948.4 this run, so there is no verified liquidation magnet above spot right now - if you get a cleaner read on the CoinGlass heatmap or a fresh OKX pull overnight, it is worth naming one. Watch the Asian session for thin-liquidity moves through the stop, and check whether the 22 September ETF print holds at plus 364.4 million once fully settled.

lesson.pattern: Twice now (21 September endday, tonight) the trigger for an overnight defensive trim was open interest falling while price stayed flat or barely moved, paired with a Fear-and-Greed pullback from an extreme - never a raw RSI or MACD reading in isolation, and never while the EMA structure or the L/S positioning was actually broken.
lesson.insight: A momentum oscillator sizes a trade; a change in who is actually positioned (OI, funding, account ratio, sentiment index) triggers one. Tonight's version was milder than 21 September's - OI fell 0.44 percent versus 3.35 percent - so the trim was sized smaller too, 8 percent versus 10 percent. Scale the action to the size of the structural fact, not to a fixed rule.
